top_signals.title: IEA Slashes Oil Demand View on War, Warns of Further Slump
top_signals.summary: The International Energy Agency cut forecasts for oil demand this year and warned consumption may decline further in the coming months as the Iran war drags on and consumers are forced to adjust to lower supply.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: The oil shock is testing private credit borrowers already burdened by high debt costs
top_signals.summary: Oil near $100 could further squeeze leveraged private credit borrowers as investors weigh the risk that inflation could push interest rates higher again.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Standard Chartered forecasts SKY rising fivefold to $0.325 by 2028
top_signals.summary: The bank expects Sky to pass five times as much value to token holders by 2028 as USDS adoption and borrowing capacity continue to expand.
